logical.byte_bit_rule: v3 b_S=b_R=1 means Byte/element, not 1-bit arithmetic. Encoded copies add physical occupancy, never logical payload.

physical.encoding: eight independent binary storage bits per signed INT8 weight; no analog tuning
physical.physical_organization: 32 slices x 512 Byte; eight slices per 4 KiB sector; two full pages per slice
physical.update_shape: arbitrary full-matrix sustained overwrite; erase four dedicated sectors, program all sixty-four pages

neurosim_array_assignment.rule: Never substitute logical K,N for a physical array; preserve native banks, plane orientation, active rows, isolation and access direction.

physical.access_direction: slice s stores input rows s, s+32, s+64, s+96; each row stores all 128 output weights

device.native_technology_policy: Retain native device bias/load/geometry independently of the low-voltage peripheral technology; no 28nm Technology table or enum relabeling.

native_electrical_parameter_policy.fallback: retain native complete service or stated primitive; never silently use upstream default device/load

page_and_binary_read.status: native complete read and page/sector P/E retained; internal implementation not separately specified

clock.rule: actual=max(target_period_ns, measured used sensing/combinational critical path); DFF alone does not prove closure

periphery.scope: Low-voltage peripheral candidates only; native array/driver/sense complete services retain their original load and bias.

native_declared.physical_write_parallelism: one native page engine; internal cell parallelism not reported

resources.capacity_policy: Installed capacity is not active parallelism. No extra ADC, SA, hold bank, driver or mux lane may appear without a resource edit.

mux_scope.rule: Ratios express selected outputs/local addresses; native row/layer/CIMSEL decoding is separate. No switch capacitance or RC assumed from fanin alone.

call.count_owner: stage.count owns schedule occurrences; only DFF one-cycle timing, multiplied by explicit per-occurrence cycle factor; no additional Adder/AdderTree ceil-cycle summation
call.aggregation_status: Candidate primitives specify interface and ownership only. Existing v3 cycle count is reference schedule, not an executed NeuroSim replacement; combine sequential component occupancies after load/clock/count mapping is resolved.

cycles_per_occurrence.source: one existing scheduled register-to-register tick per stage.count occurrence

timing_plan.formula: stage.count * cycles_per_occurrence * lv_core.actual_period_ns; apply schedule-dependent cycle factor before summing different page kinds
timing_plan.DFF_role: sole cycle timer; existing end-of-cycle register capture is within this tick
timing_plan.AdderTree_role: physical asynchronous critical_path_qualification_only; synchronous ceil-cycles are NOT added
timing_plan.actual_clock_rule: max(5ns,all used register-to-register combinational/sense requirements); native case loads still require closure
timing_plan.combinational_path_rule: Sum serial logic delays on each register-to-register path (including reduction,sign/shift,accumulation); then take max across paths and target. Do not take max of individual serial gates.

implementation_plan.no_double_counting: Native opaque stages exclude replacement charges for their included stages. For constituent-mode stages, charge only listed primitives; calculator function is provenance, not a command to add its total again.

service_schedules.semantics: Ordered loops; execute each nested stage before advancing the enclosing group/attempt. Top-level flat dependencies must not globally reorder phases. Zero new payload in maintenance.
